products.name: InSinkErator standard garbage-disposal sink flange
products.headline: 4.5 × 1.75 in standard flange
products.fit: InSinkErator disposals · 4 exact finishes · not extended
products.summary: A genuine InSinkErator standard sink flange for connecting an InSinkErator garbage disposal to a kitchen-sink drain. Choose the exact finish SKU: oil-rubbed bronze, matte black, brushed stainless steel, or white. Each flange measures 4.5 inches across by 1.75 inches deep. Before ordering, confirm the disposal brand and measure the sink thickness or existing mounting assembly; a thick farmhouse sink may require an extended flange instead.

sharedSpecs.name: Check before ordering
sharedSpecs.value: Disposal brand, sink thickness, existing mounting assembly and exact finish

sharedSpecs.name: Not for
sharedSpecs.value: Thick sinks requiring an extended flange or unverified non-InSinkErator disposals

exclusions: Do not use when the sink thickness or existing mount requires an extended flange.
Do not claim compatibility with another disposal brand without model-specific confirmation.
The baffle, stopper and disposal are not included.
Do not clean the decorative finish with abrasive solutions.

faqs.q: Will this flange fit every kitchen sink?
faqs.a: No. It is a standard 4.5 by 1.75 inch flange. Measure the sink thickness and existing mounting assembly; a thick farmhouse sink may require an extended InSinkErator flange.

faqs.q: Does this fit every garbage disposal brand?
faqs.a: It is specified for InSinkErator-manufactured garbage disposals. Brand alone should not be extended to another disposer without confirmed mounting compatibility.

faqs.q: What is included?
faqs.a: One standard decorative flange in the selected finish. The baffle, stopper and garbage disposal are not included.

faqs.q: Are matte black and oil-rubbed bronze the same finish?
faqs.a: No. Matte black is a flat black finish. Oil-rubbed bronze is a deep brown finish with copper-toned distressed edges. Select the exact SKU.

faqs.q: How do I choose between brushed stainless and white?
faqs.a: Match the flange to the sink or faucet finish. FLG-SSB is brushed stainless steel; FLG-WH is bright semi-gloss white.

products.name: Evolution antimicrobial Quiet Collar sink baffle
products.headline: Evolution series, not Badger
products.fit: QCB-AM · removable antimicrobial baffle · no tools
products.summary: A genuine InSinkErator QCB-AM removable Quiet Collar sink baffle for compatible Evolution-series garbage disposals. It reduces disposal noise and upward splash, and its antimicrobial material helps inhibit odor-causing bacteria. Select by the QCB-AM part number and disposal series rather than by a seller's nominal diameter; it is not the baffle for Badger disposals.

specs.name: Functions
specs.value: Reduces noise and upward food or water splash

specs.name: Fit method
specs.value: Match QCB-AM and the disposal series; do not select by nominal diameter alone

exclusions: Do not promise fit from a nominal diameter alone because sellers measure different points of the baffle.

faqs.q: Does QCB-AM fit an InSinkErator Badger disposal?
faqs.a: No. QCB-AM is sold for compatible Evolution-series disposals and is explicitly not the Badger baffle.

faqs.q: Why do published baffle diameters differ?
faqs.a: Retailers measure different edges or grooves. Confirm the QCB-AM part number and disposal series instead of relying on one nominal diameter.

faqs.q: Does installation require tools?
faqs.a: No. Remove the old baffle and press QCB-AM into the sink opening until its retaining groove engages.

faqs.q: What does the antimicrobial feature do?
faqs.a: It helps inhibit the growth of odor-causing bacteria. It does not replace regular removal and cleaning.

products.name: Kohler dishwasher air gap, vibrant brushed nickel
products.headline: 1–1.1875 in mounting hole
products.fit: 2 in max deck · 5/8 in inlet · 7/8 in outlet
products.summary: A complete Kohler K-9110-BN dishwasher air-gap body and solid-brass cover in Vibrant Brushed Nickel. It mounts through a 1 to 1.1875 inch sink-deck hole, supports a deck up to 2 inches thick, and uses a 5/8 inch dishwasher inlet with a 7/8 inch outlet to the disposal or sink drain. This is the body-and-cover kit, not a decorative cap alone and not the Vibrant Stainless variant.

specs.name: Included
specs.value: Durable plastic air-gap body and solid-brass cover

exclusions: Not for mounting holes larger than 1.1875 inches or decks thicker than 2 inches.
Do not substitute K-9110-VS Vibrant Stainless for this brushed-nickel SKU.
Do not list as a cover-only product; the body and cover are included.
Confirm the 5/8-inch inlet and 7/8-inch outlet hose sizes before installation.

faqs.q: Does K-9110-BN include the air-gap body?
faqs.a: Yes. It includes the plastic valve body and solid-brass Vibrant Brushed Nickel cover.

faqs.q: What mounting hole does it require?
faqs.a: A hole from 1 inch through 1.1875 inches in diameter, through a deck no thicker than 2 inches.

faqs.q: What hose connections does it use?
faqs.a: A 5/8-inch dishwasher inlet and a 7/8-inch outlet to the disposal or sink drain.

faqs.q: Is Vibrant Brushed Nickel the same as Vibrant Stainless?
faqs.a: No. K-9110-BN is Vibrant Brushed Nickel. K-9110-VS is a separate finish variant.
